chain.title: Berry First Steps
chain.desc: Wild Strawberries spawn in grassy biomes and are the only starting source of the strawberry line.

chain.title: Pick of the Patch
chain.desc: Strawberries harvested from the crop feed jams, cakes and the Linzer Tart.

chain.title: Sowing Your Wild Oats
chain.desc: Oat grows from oat seeds made with wheat seeds and bone meal, and bales up for storage.

chain.title: The Rise Guy
chain.desc: Brown mushroom, sugar and water make Yeast, the leavening in every proper loaf.

chain.title: Bowled Over
chain.desc: The Crafting Bowl is the mixing station where all three doughs come together.

chain.title: A Small Pot With Big Plans
chain.desc: The Small Cooking Pot simmers jams, truffles and pudding.

chain.title: Fired Up
chain.desc: A Brick Oven built from bricks, a campfire, logs and iron is the bakery's baking heat.

chain.title: Knead for Speed
chain.desc: Wheat, yeast, sugar and water beaten in the crafting bowl produce plain Dough.

chain.title: Bread Winner
chain.desc: Dough baked in a stove with sugar and water yields Bakers Bread, three loaves at a time.

chain.title: Jarring Discovery
chain.desc: Glass panes and wooden slabs make the Jar every preserve is sealed in.

chain.title: Jam Session
chain.desc: Strawberries, sugar and a jar cook down in the pot into Strawberry Jam.

chain.title: Sweet Talk
chain.desc: Wheat, egg, sugar and water make Sweet Dough, the pastry-grade base.

chain.title: Crescent Roll Call
chain.desc: Sweet dough, yeast and sugar bake into flaky Croissants.

chain.title: Cut of the Crop
chain.desc: The Bread Knife slices placed cakes and loaves into servings.

chain.title: Caking Under Pressure
chain.desc: The Caking Station is where cake dough and a filling become a finished cake.

chain.title: Batter Up
chain.desc: Wheat, egg, milk and sugar whisk into Cake Dough at the crafting bowl.

chain.title: Truffle Shuffle
chain.desc: Cocoa beans, milk and wheat cook in the pot into Chocolate Truffles.

chain.title: Have Your Cake
chain.desc: Cake dough and strawberry jam combine at the Caking Station into a full Strawberry Cake.

chain.title: Tart of Darkness
chain.desc: Sweet dough, chocolate and yeast bake in the stove into a Chocolate Tart.

chain.title: Gateau Crashers
chain.desc: Cake dough and a chocolate truffle at the Caking Station make the Chocolate Gateau, the bakery's finest showpiece.

notes: Three-station spine read from data/bakery/recipes: crafting_bowl makes the doughs, pot_cooking makes jams and truffles, stove bakes breads and tarts, baking_station makes cakes and cookies. Note the jar registers several bakery items under a lang key with a _block suffix (bakery:bread is block.bakery.bread_block, likewise baguette, bun, braided_bread, crusty_bread, toast, waffle); these were kept because the jar's own stove recipes output those exact item ids. Every stove other than brick_stove is a cosmetic variant of the same station. Dropped as unverifiable: cake_tower, faucet, milk_bread, pancake, shelf (item models with no lang key and no recipe output in this jar).
